subject: general
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

SW-NR-IM

IM-DH-YC
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**SW : NR : IM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a836c6b8efcab8a28b71ff2ed1982dc3028adb7cc6015aa3d4a8bd56ca0854e.png] 

**IM : DH : YC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32829f4bd49a5fc9f104e2cd9a5155ef23ec74a8b875299b9b9fdd77d14c45cd.png] 

 

**Option 1: UY-PT-LO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6aec331fed2ad71012660174f1774409535fb3fa97c03de6b86dd0026e4ac320.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern.

**Option 2: FJ-AE-WZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/039101db4526179d1a47af58a53f38a4d460852829ee92b4f799d50c39f4e063.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern. 

**Option 3: YC-TX-OS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df6508a18afc741b470452be115679a180a18b713193b4086566a9f0dcb6f2aa.png] 

This option **follows the pattern**.

**Option 4: HL-DG-XB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c2a6c3eb8a8a86d2bf6a52e5b4982dd1895d0b1cc776846be4b2ffa3df282d9.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
